metadata.description: Runtime analysis settings.
Compile-time capabilities mapped to Config.sh.
metadata.rationale: Profiles override the shared defaults; native names and discovery tags are carried by individual fields. Defaults are example configuration choices, not general scientific recommendations.

metadata.description: X-boundary mode; zero leaves no REFLECTIVE_X compile option.
Y-boundary mode; zero leaves no REFLECTIVE_Y compile option.
Z-boundary mode; zero leaves no REFLECTIVE_Z compile option.
Restrict the Voronoi mesh and hydrodynamics to one dimension.
Restrict the Voronoi mesh and hydrodynamics to two dimensions.
Use one-dimensional spherical geometry.
metadata.scientific_impact: Uses the first coordinate as radius under spherical symmetry.

metadata.description: Use a static Voronoi mesh.
metadata.performance_impact: Disables domain decomposition by default; mesh-generating points have zero velocity.

metadata.description: Compile radiative cooling and UV-background support.
metadata.scientific_impact: Enables primordial cooling physics and conversions to proper cgs quantities.

metadata.description: Compile the Springel-Hernquist multiphase star-formation model.
metadata.scientific_impact: Turns eligible dense gas into collisionless star particles using the Springel-Hernquist (2003) model.

metadata.description: Enforce the Jeans-stability temperature floor for gas cells.
metadata.scientific_impact: Imposes an adaptive temperature floor intended to keep the Jeans length resolved.

metadata.description: Compile ideal magnetohydrodynamics.
metadata.scientific_impact: Evolves ideal MHD; a zero initial magnetic field remains zero under the ideal-MHD equations.

metadata.description: Use Powell eight-wave divergence-control terms for MHD.
metadata.scientific_impact: Adds Powell eight-wave divergence-control terms to the MHD equations.

metadata.description: Limit timesteps for Powell divergence-control stability.
metadata.performance_impact: Adds a timestep constraint required by Powell divergence control.

metadata.description: Compile-time gas adiabatic index; zero selects Arepo's default.
metadata.rationale: A value of zero delegates to Arepo's ideal-hydrodynamics default of 5/3.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the equation-of-state adiabatic index for ideal hydrodynamics.

metadata.description: Compile gravitational interactions between particles and cells.
Use hierarchical gravity time integration.
metadata.scientific_impact: Uses hierarchical splitting of gravitational time integration.

metadata.description: Evaluate cell gravity at geometric centres; requires hierarchical gravity.
Allow direct summation for small active particle sets.
metadata.performance_impact: Avoids tree-walk overhead for sufficiently small active particle sets.

metadata.description: Active-particle threshold below which direct gravity summation is used.
metadata.recommended_range: Positive; Arepo's documented default is 3000 active particles.
metadata.performance_impact: Increasing the threshold selects direct summation for more active-particle sets.

metadata.description: Retain component-specific softenings when using softened tree nodes.
metadata.performance_impact: Can avoid a substantial tree-walk penalty from opening softened nodes, but stores component masses per tree node.
metadata.scientific_impact: Approximates component centres of mass separately when evaluating softened node-particle interactions.

metadata.description: Particle-type bit mask selecting individual gravity softening.
metadata.scientific_impact: Assigns selected particle types a softening based on mass relative to type 1; primarily useful for zoom simulations.

metadata.description: Enable periodic particle-mesh gravity in the TreePM solver.
Particle-mesh cells per dimension; zero is disabled.
metadata.recommended_range: At least 256 for TreePM accuracy; powers of two are fastest for FFTs.
metadata.performance_impact: Larger grids increase PM-force resolution, memory use, and FFT cost.
metadata.scientific_impact: Enables TreePM, using PM for long-range and the tree for short-range forces.

metadata.description: TreePM short-range cutoff in particle-mesh cell units.
metadata.rationale: 4.5 mesh cells is Arepo's documented default.
metadata.performance_impact: Larger cutoffs extend the tree calculation further from each particle.

metadata.description: Particle-type mask defining the TreePM high-resolution region.
metadata.scientific_impact: Adds a high-resolution Fourier mesh around the selected particle types for zoom simulations.

metadata.description: Expansion factor for the TreePM high-resolution region.
metadata.performance_impact: A larger buffer reduces expensive high-resolution mesh-geometry recalculations for expanding particle sets.

metadata.description: Resolution multiplier for a zoom TreePM grid.
metadata.performance_impact: Changes high-resolution FFT mesh size in proportion to PMGRID.

metadata.description: Use the TreePM algorithm optimized for cosmological zoom simulations.
metadata.performance_impact: Uses a communication algorithm robust to clustered zoom data, but slower than the default for homogeneous periodic boxes.

metadata.description: Compile non-periodic gravity.
Calculate gravitational potentials.
metadata.performance_impact: Computes potential energy whenever global statistics are measured.
metadata.scientific_impact: Enables potential-energy diagnostics for global energy-conservation tests.

metadata.description: Number of available gravitational-softening families.
metadata.rationale: Defaults to Arepo's NTYPES (six in this source tree) when NSOFTTYPES is omitted; must match the configured SofteningComovingTypeN entries.
metadata.scientific_impact: Defines the available gravity-softening families that particle types may share.

metadata.description: Force all particles/cells onto equal timesteps.
metadata.performance_impact: Can increase computational work by preventing individual adaptive timesteps.

metadata.description: Use the non-local, tree-based timestep criterion.
Arepo precision mode; zero leaves DOUBLEPRECISION unspecified.
Use double-precision FFTW transforms.
Use double precision for neighbor-tree node extensions.
Compile HDF5 snapshot and initial-condition support.
Reduce log-file flush frequency.
metadata.performance_impact: Reduces filesystem flush activity by avoiding flushes at every synchronization point.

metadata.description: Read initial conditions in double precision.
Always write coordinates in double precision.
Write snapshot fields in double precision.
Interpret IC Mass fields as densities.
Write the supplementary cpu.csv performance log.
Generate gas particles from dark-matter-only initial conditions.
Compile cell refinement and derefinement.
metadata.scientific_impact: Enables dynamic cell refinement and derefinement; the default target is gas-cell mass.

metadata.description: Compile adaptive gas-cell gravitational softening.
metadata.scientific_impact: Varies hydro-cell softening with cell radius using the runtime adaptive-softening table.

metadata.description: Regularize mesh cells using their maximum face angle.
Regularize mesh-generating-point drift from cell centres of mass.
Limit centre-of-mass regularization by local sound speed.
Compile volume-limited mesh refinement.
metadata.scientific_impact: Enforces absolute cell-volume bounds and a maximum neighbouring-cell volume contrast.

metadata.description: Exclude the background grid from refinement.
metadata.scientific_impact: Prevents derefinement of sufficiently large background cells in cosmological zoom simulations.

metadata.description: Allow configurations that exceed the Peano-grid warning threshold.
Use the HLLD Riemann solver for ideal MHD.
metadata.scientific_impact: Selects the HLLD approximate Riemann solver required for MHD.

metadata.description: Compile the friends-of-friends halo finder.
Particle-type bit mask used as FoF primary linking tracers.
Particle-type bit mask attached to nearest FoF primary tracers.
Compile the Subfind substructure finder; requires FoF.
Save Subfind smoothing lengths, densities, and velocity dispersions.
Calculate additional Subfind velocity-dispersion information.
Calculate extended Subfind angular-momentum and energy properties.
Process output-list times before starting to improve timing accuracy.
Write gas-cell centres of mass.
Write magnetic-field gradients.
Write gravitational accelerations.
Write pressure gradients.
Write gravitational potentials.
Enable Arepo debugging facilities and core-dump support.
Radiative cooling input.
Cooling and UV-background table used by Arepo.
Cosmological background parameters.
Present-day total matter density parameter, Omega0.
metadata.scientific_impact: Defines the z=0 matter density relative to critical density for comoving integration and halo/subhalo finding.

metadata.description: Present-day baryon density parameter, OmegaBaryon.
metadata.scientific_impact: Defines the z=0 baryon density relative to critical density for comoving integration, halo/subhalo finding, and star formation.

metadata.description: Dimensionless Hubble parameter h, written to HubbleParam.
metadata.rationale: For gravity and adiabatic gas dynamics Arepo absorbs h into its code units; use 1.0 unless conversions to proper cgs units, such as radiative cooling, are required.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the z=0 Hubble constant in units of 100 km s^-1 Mpc^-1 for physics that converts to proper cgs units.

metadata.description: Initial redshift from which the scale-factor start time is derived.
Final redshift from which the scale-factor end time is derived.
Present-day dark-energy density parameter, OmegaLambda.
metadata.rationale: Often derived from the remaining density budget of a flat cosmology.
metadata.scientific_impact: Defines the z=0 vacuum-energy density relative to critical density for comoving integration and halo/subhalo finding.

metadata.description: Present-day non-baryonic matter density derived from total and baryon density.
metadata.scientific_impact: Represents the non-baryonic matter component implied by the total and baryon density parameters.

metadata.description: Continuation-job submission settings.
Whether Arepo should submit a continuation job after reaching its time limit.
Command used to submit the continuation job when resubmission is enabled.
Local experiment identity settings.
metadata.rationale: Schema organization and setup identifiers belong to this DIPL integration, not to the native AREPO parameter format.

metadata.description: Local selection of bundled AREPO examples.
metadata.rationale: Schema organization and setup identifiers belong to this DIPL integration, not to the native AREPO parameter format.

metadata.description: Selects the scientific setup branch represented by this DIPL environment.
Domain decomposition controls.
Number of simultaneous domain decompositions.
metadata.performance_impact: Too few domains can prevent simultaneous CPU and memory load balance; too many increase MPI communication across domain boundaries.

metadata.description: Top-level tree-node allocation factor.
metadata.performance_impact: Higher values enable finer Peano-Hilbert load cuts but increase the replicated top-level-tree memory on every MPI rank.

metadata.description: Active-particle fraction that triggers a domain decomposition.
metadata.performance_impact: Larger values avoid domain-decomposition work at synchronization points with few active particles.

metadata.description: Gravity accuracy controls.
Integration accuracy tolerance.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets eta in the gravitational timestep criterion; collisionless cosmological timesteps scale approximately as eta^0.5.

metadata.description: Tree opening angle.
metadata.scientific_impact: Controls the initial Barnes-Hut force estimate and all tree forces when the geometric opening criterion is selected.

metadata.description: Relative force-error tolerance.
metadata.scientific_impact: Controls tree-force accuracy when using Arepo's relative opening criterion.

metadata.description: Tree opening-criterion selector.
metadata.recommended_range: 1 (relative opening criterion), which Arepo normally recommends.
metadata.scientific_impact: Selects relative force-error control (1) or the geometric Barnes-Hut criterion (0).

metadata.description: Adaptive gas softening settings.
Gas-cell softening relative to the assigned base softening.
metadata.scientific_impact: Adaptive gas-cell softening is selected from a logarithmically spaced table after scaling the cell radius by this factor.

metadata.description: Minimum comoving adaptive gas softening.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the smallest entry in the adaptive gas-softening table.

metadata.description: Geometric spacing between adaptive gas softening levels.
metadata.recommended_range: At least 1; values define the geometric ratio between adjacent adaptive softening levels.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the spacing of the logarithmic adaptive gas-softening table.

metadata.description: Gravity and softening settings.
Gravitational constant in the selected internal code-unit system.
metadata.rationale: Zero asks Arepo to derive the physical value from the selected code units.
metadata.scientific_impact: An explicit value defines a non-standard or natural unit system; it should not be set for cosmological integrations.

metadata.description: One gravitational softening length.
metadata.rationale: DIPL collection items are containers, so the scalar length is represented by a named child.

metadata.description: Gravity softening length in Arepo code-length units; the schema default is overridden by each setup.
metadata.scientific_impact: A softening family may be shared by multiple particle types; its comoving and maximum physical values control short-range gravitational resolution.

metadata.description: Gas evolution controls.
Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy timestep factor.
metadata.scientific_impact: Multiplies the cell-wise CFL condition and therefore directly limits hydrodynamical timesteps.

metadata.description: Initial gas temperature used where initial conditions lack it.
metadata.scientific_impact: Applied only when positive and when the IC gas temperature is zero; the assumed ionization state changes above 10^4 K.

metadata.description: Temperature floor applied to gas.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets a thermodynamic floor for cooling physics.

metadata.description: Minimum density imposed while starting the run.
metadata.scientific_impact: All gas cells below this density immediately after IC loading are raised to this value.

metadata.description: Density threshold for an internal-energy limit.
metadata.scientific_impact: Activates the associated internal-energy floor below this density threshold.

metadata.description: Internal-energy floor applied below the configured density threshold.
metadata.scientific_impact: Prevents gas below the configured density threshold from cooling below this internal energy.

metadata.description: Minimum specific internal energy.
metadata.scientific_impact: Provides a global lower bound on the gas specific internal energy.

metadata.description: Desired hydrodynamic neighbor count.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the target number of nearest neighbours used for the initial gas-cell density/size estimate.

metadata.description: Permitted deviation from the desired neighbor count.
metadata.performance_impact: A larger tolerance reduces iterations required to determine the correct initial neighbour radius.

metadata.description: Initial-condition paths and formats.
Initial-condition file path, without an automatically appended format suffix.
metadata.rationale: For multi-file ICs specify the basename without the trailing file number; for HDF5 omit the .hdf5 suffix because Arepo appends it.

metadata.description: Serialization format used to read the initial conditions.
metadata.recommended_range: 3 (HDF5), unless a legacy binary format is specifically required.

metadata.description: Simulation input settings.
Per-rank memory allocation.
Memory allocated to each MPI rank, in MiB.
metadata.recommended_range: Up to about 95% of physical memory available per MPI rank.
metadata.performance_impact: Arepo reserves one contiguous pool of this size at startup; insufficient space terminates the run, while excessive allocation leaves too little room for MPI and the operating system.

metadata.description: Refinement and derefinement controls.
Reference gas-cell mass for refinement.
metadata.scientific_impact: Defines the mass scale around which the default refinement and derefinement maintain gas-cell resolution.

metadata.description: Target gas-mass multiplier for refinement.
metadata.scientific_impact: Scales the reference gas-cell mass used by the refinement target.

metadata.description: Arepo refinement-criterion selector.
metadata.scientific_impact: Selects the algorithm governing when gas cells are refined.

metadata.description: Arepo derefinement-criterion selector.
metadata.scientific_impact: Selects the algorithm governing when gas cells are derefined.

metadata.description: Mesh regularization controls.
Speed of mesh regularization.
metadata.performance_impact: Controls the strength of mesh-generator motion used to restore cell roundness.

metadata.description: Maximum-face-angle roundness threshold.
metadata.scientific_impact: Elongated cells above the face-angle thresholds are not refined and their mesh generators are moved away from pure Lagrangian motion.

metadata.description: Centre-of-mass mesh-roundness threshold; zero disables this criterion.
metadata.scientific_impact: Large centre-of-mass offsets suppress refinement and add mesh-generator motion to restore roundness.

metadata.description: Mesh adaptation settings.
Explicit snapshot scheduling.
Whether Arepo reads an explicit output-time schedule file.
metadata.scientific_impact: Selects explicitly chosen output epochs instead of the regular cadence defined by simulation.time.first_snapshot and simulation.time.snapshot_interval.

metadata.description: Path to the output-time schedule file when scheduling is enabled.
Snapshot and scheduling settings.
Memory and execution resources.
Computational box size.
Simulation-box edge length in the selected Arepo code-length unit.
metadata.scientific_impact: Initial-condition coordinates normally must lie within [0, BoxSize] in every dimension.

metadata.description: Domain extent and boundaries.
Whether the simulation domain has periodic boundaries.
metadata.scientific_impact: Controls gravitational boundary conditions; hydrodynamic boundaries are compile-time directional settings.

metadata.description: Spatial and temporal settings.
Integration interval and output cadence.
Independent coordinate used by the time integrator.
metadata.scientific_impact: With scale_factor, Arepo evolves an expanding cosmology and uses scale factor as its time coordinate; linear uses Newtonian physical coordinates.

metadata.description: Redshift represented by the initial conditions.
Redshift at which a cosmological integration ends.
Initial integration coordinate; often derived from the initial redshift.
metadata.scientific_impact: For a cosmological run this is the initial scale factor.

metadata.description: Final integration coordinate.
metadata.scientific_impact: For a cosmological run this is the final scale factor.

metadata.description: Maximum permitted integration step.
metadata.rationale: Protects particles with very small accelerations from unphysically large timesteps.
metadata.scientific_impact: For comoving integrations this caps dln(a).

metadata.description: Minimum permitted integration step; zero delegates the lower limit to Arepo.
metadata.scientific_impact: A requested smaller step normally stops Arepo; NOSTOP_WHEN_BELOW_MINTIMESTEP instead clamps it to this value.

metadata.description: Interval between time-statistics reports.
metadata.performance_impact: More frequent measurements increase diagnostic I/O; gravitational potential energy additionally requires build.gravity.evaluate_potential.

metadata.description: First regularly spaced snapshot time when no output schedule is used.
metadata.scientific_impact: For cosmological simulations this is the first output scale factor.

metadata.description: Spacing of regular snapshots when no output schedule is used.
metadata.scientific_impact: Spacing is logarithmic in scale factor for cosmological runs and linear in time otherwise.

metadata.description: Global time-step criterion used by Arepo.
metadata.recommended_range: 0; this is the only criterion currently supported by Arepo.

metadata.description: Snapshot naming and storage.
Directory receiving Arepo snapshots.
Prefix used for snapshot filenames.
Arepo snapshot serialization format.
metadata.recommended_range: 3 (HDF5), unless a legacy binary format is specifically required.

metadata.description: Number of files produced for each snapshot.
metadata.recommended_range: 1 through the number of MPI ranks.
metadata.performance_impact: Splitting a snapshot can improve I/O throughput and avoid very large files, depending on the filesystem.

metadata.description: Maximum number of snapshot files written concurrently.
metadata.recommended_range: No greater than the number of MPI ranks.
metadata.performance_impact: Restricting concurrency can protect heavily used filesystems on large runs, at the cost of slower I/O.

metadata.description: Star-formation model parameters.
Critical overdensity above which star formation may occur in a comoving integration.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the redshift-independent overdensity threshold for star formation in comoving integrations.

metadata.description: Maximum gas temperature eligible for star formation.
metadata.scientific_impact: Prevents star formation in gas hotter than the effective equation of state and this threshold; a low value excludes hot halo gas.

metadata.description: Critical physical density above which star formation may occur in a non-comoving integration.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the physical-density threshold used instead of critical_overdensity in non-comoving integrations.

metadata.description: Hot inter-cloud-medium temperature in the Springel-Hernquist model.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the hot inter-cloud-medium temperature in the Springel-Hernquist model.

metadata.description: Cold-cloud temperature in the Springel-Hernquist model.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the cold-cloud temperature in the Springel-Hernquist model.

metadata.description: Star-formation timescale at the density threshold.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the star-formation timescale at threshold density; the local timescale decreases as density to the power -0.5.

metadata.description: Mass fraction of massive stars formed for an initial stellar population.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the stellar-IMF mass fraction assigned to massive stars above 8 solar masses.

metadata.description: Cloud-evaporation efficiency in the Springel-Hernquist model.
metadata.scientific_impact: Sets the cloud-evaporation efficiency A in the Springel-Hernquist model.

metadata.description: Subfind runtime controls.
Minimum number of particles/cells retained in a Subfind group.
Subfind tree opening angle.
Runtime limits and restart intervals.
Wall-clock limit before Arepo stops cleanly for restart.
metadata.rationale: Arepo begins clean termination and restart-file writing after 85% of this limit, reserving the remaining time for the final timestep and I/O.

metadata.description: Interval between restart-file writes.
metadata.performance_impact: Shorter intervals reduce work lost after an unexpected interruption but increase restart I/O.

metadata.description: Interval between explicit log-file flushes; zero leaves this disabled.
metadata.performance_impact: A shorter interval improves log durability but increases filesystem activity.
